item.title: deeplearning4j/deeplearning4j
item.author: emecas
item.description:
deeplearning4j/deeplearning4j
Suite of tools for deploying and training deep learning models using the JVM. Highlights include model import for keras, tensorflow, and onnx/pytorch, a modular and tiny c++ library for running math code and a java based math library on top of the core c++ library. Also includes samediff: a pytorch/tensorflow like library for running deep learn…
Java repository by deeplearning4j, created in 2013, with 14,278 stars and 3,817 forks. License: Apache-2.0. Starred on 2019-01-24.
Homepage: http://deeplearning4j.konduit.ai
https://github.com/deeplearning4j/deeplearning4j
